_doc: YEARSIM-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21): 'How is this going to run for a year unattended and keep improving itself with absolutely zero external input? That's a key test.' Twelve simulated months, one injected failure each, run by foundation/yearsim.py against a scratch copy. A month with scenario null is an area the simulation cannot reach yet: it is reported UNCOVERED and carries the id of the queue item that closes the gap. Consumers: foundation/yearsim.py, .github/workflows/yearsim.yml, site/yearsim.js, tests/foundation/test_yearsim.py.

months.failure: fresh copy of the repository must boot its own heartbeat
a domain without auto-renew is 10 days from lapsing
usage grows toward the free-plan cap
the lane loses its rebase guard
a failure item nobody repairs for nine days
a queue item closed with no evidence
a new dependency manifest has no update bot watching it
the Practical Solutions loops (scan, pipeline, advocates, deploys) run a year; its scheduled workflows fire and honour the halt
a fresh setup must register one app, never more
months.why: GitHub offers no API to delete a keyless app or its installation; reuse is tested in seed/worker/test/auth.test.js, not in this run

months.failure: after twelve months the runway still meets the target
